program='''def transform(grid):
    counts = {v: sum(cell == v for row in grid for cell in row)
              for v in {cell for row in grid for cell in row} if v != 0}
    ordered = sorted(counts, key=counts.get, reverse=True)
    background, shape = ordered[:2]
    special = ordered[2] if len(ordered) > 2 else None
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == shape]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    side = max(r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, 4)
    r0 = (r0+r1+1-side)//2; c0 = (c0+c1+1-side)//2
    r1 = r0+side-1; c1 = c0+side-1
    out = [[background for _ in row] for row in grid]
    if special is None:
        for r in range(r0-2, r1+3):
            for c in range(c0-2, c1+3):
                out[r][c] = 0
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r][c] = shape
    if special is not None:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == special]
        sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        h, w = max(sr1-sr0+1, 2), max(sc1-sc0+1, 2)
        sr0 = (sr0+sr1+1-h)//2; sc0 = (sc0+sc1+1-w)//2
        for r in range(sr0, sr0+h):
            for c in range(sc0, sc0+w):
                out[r][c] = special
    return out
'''
